# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 0.1.0 - 2026-11-10

- First version: Zoom remote MCP server over streamable HTTP.
- Added the 2 agent skills (`zoom-flagship-mcp`, `zoom-search`) published in `zoom/zoom-mcp-plugin-for-claude` (commit `da551f5d`), copied unchanged, with Zoom's MIT licence in `skills/LICENSE`.
